```python
"""FastMCP server exposing a reusable 'summarize' prompt template."""

from fastmcp import FastMCP
from fastmcp.prompts import Message

mcp = FastMCP(name="summarize-server")


@mcp.prompt(name="summarize")
def summarize(text: str) -> list[Message]:
    return [
        Message(f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}"),
    ]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcp.run()
```
